statement: Not a bounty -- Stage 0 of docs/cairn-integration-plan.md. Independently re-verify a claimed factor-base relation certificate already produced by crypto-autoresearcher's own harness (docs/claims-and-verification.md): given curve {p, a, b}, a target point, and a non-empty list of summand points, accept iff every summand is on the curve and their sum equals the target. reward is 0 because this objective funds nothing -- see discrete-log-reverification.json for the shared rationale.

curve.description: Short Weierstrass y^2 = x^3 + a*x + b over F_p, p > 3.

summands.description: Non-empty list of [x, y] points on the curve, summing to target.
